title: Playboy June 1988 Playmate of the Year Chevy Chase Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Covers bright; spine intact. Light scuffs and white scratch marks on the dark front cover, mostly at the right edge (see photo 2), and a small scuffed spot near the bottom of the back cover. No tears. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
description:
Playboy magazine, June 1988 - Playmate of the Year issue, original $4.00 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: The Playmate of the Year; Playboy Interview with Chevy Chase; Playboy's Build-Your-Own Candidate.

Back cover: Budweiser 'King of Beers' swimsuit ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
